sr_fl_1_all_rapid = {
	sr_fl_1_rapid_value > 0
	sr_fl_1_rapid_value >= sr_fl_1_strength
}
sr_fl_1_refitting = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_1_refit_until
	var:sr_fl_1_refit_until > te_history_month_index
}
# Docked: at Earth, or where we hold a world with a Spaceport (design § 2).
sr_fl_1_docked = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_1_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 2 sr_loc_port_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 3 sr_loc_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 4 sr_loc_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 5 sr_loc_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 6 sr_loc_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 7 sr_loc_port_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 8 sr_loc_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 9 sr_loc_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}

sr_fl_1_may_depart_earth = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 1 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_1_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_1_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_1_dv_value >= sr_fl_1_leg_dv_earth
}

# The panel's Go: its picked destination may be flown now.
sr_fl_1_can_go = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_1
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_1 = 1 sr_fl_1_may_depart_earth = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_1 = 2 sr_fl_1_may_depart_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_1 = 3 sr_fl_1_may_depart_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_1 = 4 sr_fl_1_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_1 = 5 sr_fl_1_may_depart_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_1 = 6 sr_fl_1_may_depart_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_1 = 7 sr_fl_1_may_depart_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_1 = 8 sr_fl_1_may_depart_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_1 = 9 sr_fl_1_may_depart_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# Another fleet of ours at the same location, to merge into.
sr_fl_1_can_merge = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
	}
}
# Strength to halve, and an empty slot to take the half.
sr_fl_1_can_detach = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc
	sr_fl_1_strength >= { value = sr_fl_minimum_strength multiply = 4 }
	sr_fl_has_free_slot = yes
}
# Marines aboard, at a location where we hold a colony; room aboard and
# marines of ours to take back.
sr_fl_1_can_land = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc
	sr_fl_1_marines_value >= 1
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 2 sr_loc_held_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 3 sr_loc_held_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 4 sr_loc_held_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 5 sr_loc_held_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 6 sr_loc_held_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 7 sr_loc_held_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 8 sr_loc_held_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 9 sr_loc_held_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
sr_fl_1_can_embark = {

	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 2 sr_loc_our_marines_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 3 sr_loc_our_marines_mars = yes }

# 6c: a world at its location it may interdict (a country at peace with us,
# not our ally, holds it); its target is one; it interdicts. Never at Earth
# (lunar colonization § 8.3).

	has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc
	OR = {

sr_fl_1_interdicting = { sr_fl_1_posture_value = 4 }
# At Earth, closing in on a lunar world (the AI's offence leaves it there).
sr_fl_1_closing_at_earth = { sr_fl_1_at_earth = yes sr_fl_1_posture_value = 3 }
# The target button: interdicting, the worlds it may interdict; else the
# hostile worlds.
sr_fl_1_can_target = {
	OR = {
		AND = { sr_fl_1_posture_value = 4 sr_fl_1_has_interdict_world = yes }
		AND = { NOT = { sr_fl_1_posture_value = 4 } sr_fl_1_has_hostile_world = yes }
	}
}
# The posture button's next step is Interdict (its price, in the tooltip).
sr_fl_1_next_interdict = {
	sr_fl_1_has_interdict_world = yes
	OR = {
		sr_fl_1_posture_value = 3
		AND = { sr_fl_1_posture_value = 2 NOT = { sr_fl_1_has_hostile_world = yes } }
	}
}
# The AI's: at Earth, or where no world of ours is threatened.
sr_fl_1_ai_free = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc
	NOT = { OR = { AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 2 sr_fl_ai_threatened_inner = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 3 sr_fl_ai_threatened_mars = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 4 sr_fl_ai_threatened_asteroids = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 5 sr_fl_ai_threatened_jupiter = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 6 sr_fl_ai_threatened_saturn = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 7 sr_fl_ai_threatened_uranus = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 8 sr_fl_ai_threatened_neptune = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 9 sr_fl_ai_threatened_kuiper = yes } } }
}
# It reaches Mercury and Venus within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_1_ai_reaches_inner = {
	OR = {
		sr_fl_1_leg_months_inner <= 6
		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_inner global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_inner >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_1_leg_months_inner } }
	}
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_1_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_1_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_1_return_dv_inner }
	}
}
# It reaches Mars within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can

# 6c: it may attack Mercury and Venus: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_1_ai_attacks_inner = {
	sr_fl_1_docked = yes
	sr_fl_1_may_depart_inner = yes
	sr_fl_1_leg_months_inner <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_1_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_1_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_1_return_dv_inner }
	}
	sr_fl_1_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_inner multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}

# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_1_ai_attacks_neptune = {
	sr_fl_1_docked = yes
	sr_fl_1_may_depart_neptune = yes
	sr_fl_1_leg_months_neptune <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_neptune = yes
		sr_fl_1_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_1_leg_dv_neptune add = sr_fl_1_return_dv_neptune }
	}
	sr_fl_1_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_neptune multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Kuiper Belt: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_1_ai_attacks_kuiper = {
	sr_fl_1_docked = yes
	sr_fl_1_may_depart_kuiper = yes
	sr_fl_1_leg_months_kuiper <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_kuiper = yes
		sr_fl_1_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_1_leg_dv_kuiper add = sr_fl_1_return_dv_kuiper }
	}
	sr_fl_1_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_kuiper multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}

# Its target is a lunar world (lunar colonization § 8.1): the only close-in at Earth.

		var:sr_fl_2_target = 35
		var:sr_fl_2_target = 36
		var:sr_fl_2_target = 37
		var:sr_fl_2_target = 38
		var:sr_fl_2_target = 39
		var:sr_fl_2_target = 40
	}
}

sr_fl_2_all_rapid = {
	sr_fl_2_rapid_value > 0
	sr_fl_2_rapid_value >= sr_fl_2_strength
}
sr_fl_2_refitting = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_2_refit_until
	var:sr_fl_2_refit_until > te_history_month_index
}
# Docked: at Earth, or where we hold a world with a Spaceport (design § 2).
sr_fl_2_docked = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 2 sr_loc_port_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 3 sr_loc_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 4 sr_loc_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 5 sr_loc_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 6 sr_loc_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 7 sr_loc_port_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 8 sr_loc_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 9 sr_loc_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# It refills fully: at Earth, or at a Spaceport on a propellant world of ours.
sr_fl_2_refills_fully = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 3 sr_loc_propellant_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 4 sr_loc_propellant_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 5 sr_loc_propellant_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 6 sr_loc_propellant_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 8 sr_loc_propellant_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 9 sr_loc_propellant_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
sr_fl_2_may_depart_earth = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_2_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_2_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_2_dv_value >= sr_fl_2_leg_dv_earth
}
sr_fl_2_may_depart_inner = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 2 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_2_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_2_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_2_dv_value >= sr_fl_2_leg_dv_inner
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}
sr_fl_2_may_depart_mars = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 3 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_2_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_2_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_2_dv_value >= sr_fl_2_leg_dv_mars
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}

	sr_fl_2_dv_value >= sr_fl_2_leg_dv_asteroids

# 6d: it is at Earth, and nothing may leave Earth (sr_launches_barred).
sr_fl_2_earth_barred = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc
	var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1
	sr_launches_barred = yes
}
# The panel's Go: its picked destination may be flown now.
sr_fl_2_can_go = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_2
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_2 = 1 sr_fl_2_may_depart_earth = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_2 = 2 sr_fl_2_may_depart_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_2 = 3 sr_fl_2_may_depart_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_2 = 4 sr_fl_2_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_2 = 5 sr_fl_2_may_depart_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_2 = 6 sr_fl_2_may_depart_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_2 = 7 sr_fl_2_may_depart_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_2 = 8 sr_fl_2_may_depart_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_2 = 9 sr_fl_2_may_depart_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# Another fleet of ours at the same location, to merge into.
sr_fl_2_can_merge = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_1_loc = var:sr_fl_2_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = var:sr_fl_2_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = var:sr_fl_2_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = var:sr_fl_2_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = var:sr_fl_2_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = var:sr_fl_2_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = var:sr_fl_2_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = var:sr_fl_2_loc }
	}
}
# Strength to halve, and an empty slot to take the half.
sr_fl_2_can_detach = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc
	sr_fl_2_strength >= { value = sr_fl_minimum_strength multiply = 4 }
	sr_fl_has_free_slot = yes
}
# Marines aboard, at a location where we hold a colony; room aboard and
# marines of ours to take back.
sr_fl_2_can_land = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc
	sr_fl_2_marines_value >= 1
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 2 sr_loc_held_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 3 sr_loc_held_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 4 sr_loc_held_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 5 sr_loc_held_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 6 sr_loc_held_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 7 sr_loc_held_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 8 sr_loc_held_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 9 sr_loc_held_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
sr_fl_2_can_embark = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc
	sr_fl_2_marine_capacity > sr_fl_2_marines_value
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 2 sr_loc_our_marines_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 3 sr_loc_our_marines_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 4 sr_loc_our_marines_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 5 sr_loc_our_marines_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 6 sr_loc_our_marines_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 7 sr_loc_our_marines_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 8 sr_loc_our_marines_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 9 sr_loc_our_marines_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# 6b: a world at its location it may close in on (at war with its holder or
# occupier, or free); its target is one. At Earth, a lunar world (lunar
# colonization § 8.1).
sr_fl_2_has_hostile_world = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = shackleton } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = peary } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = tranquility } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = marius_hills } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = daedalus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = imbrium } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 2 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mercury } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 3 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 4 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pallas } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hygiea } } }

	}

# 6c: a world at its location it may interdict (a country at peace with us,
# not our ally, holds it); its target is one; it interdicts. Never at Earth
# (lunar colonization § 8.3).
sr_fl_2_has_interdict_world = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 2 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mercury } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 3 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 4 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = pallas } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hygiea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 5 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = io } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = europa } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ganymede } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = callisto } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = himalia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = amalthea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 6 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = titan } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = enceladus } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = rhea } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mimas } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = iapetus } } }

sr_fl_2_interdicting = { sr_fl_2_posture_value = 4 }
# At Earth, closing in on a lunar world (the AI's offence leaves it there).
sr_fl_2_closing_at_earth = { sr_fl_2_at_earth = yes sr_fl_2_posture_value = 3 }
# The target button: interdicting, the worlds it may interdict; else the
# hostile worlds.
sr_fl_2_can_target = {
	OR = {
		AND = { sr_fl_2_posture_value = 4 sr_fl_2_has_interdict_world = yes }
		AND = { NOT = { sr_fl_2_posture_value = 4 } sr_fl_2_has_hostile_world = yes }
	}
}
# The posture button's next step is Interdict (its price, in the tooltip).
sr_fl_2_next_interdict = {
	sr_fl_2_has_interdict_world = yes
	OR = {
		sr_fl_2_posture_value = 3
		AND = { sr_fl_2_posture_value = 2 NOT = { sr_fl_2_has_hostile_world = yes } }
	}
}
# The AI's: at Earth, or where no world of ours is threatened.
sr_fl_2_ai_free = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc
	NOT = { OR = { AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 2 sr_fl_ai_threatened_inner = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 3 sr_fl_ai_threatened_mars = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 4 sr_fl_ai_threatened_asteroids = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 5 sr_fl_ai_threatened_jupiter = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 6 sr_fl_ai_threatened_saturn = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 7 sr_fl_ai_threatened_uranus = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 8 sr_fl_ai_threatened_neptune = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 9 sr_fl_ai_threatened_kuiper = yes } } }
}
# It reaches Mercury and Venus within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_2_ai_reaches_inner = {
	OR = {
		sr_fl_2_leg_months_inner <= 6
		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_inner global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_inner >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_2_leg_months_inner } }
	}
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_2_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_2_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_2_return_dv_inner }
	}
}
# It reaches Mars within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_2_ai_reaches_mars = {

		sr_fl_2_leg_months_mars <= 6
		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_mars global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_mars >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_2_leg_months_mars } }

	}
}

# 6c: it may attack Mercury and Venus: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_2_ai_attacks_inner = {
	sr_fl_2_docked = yes
	sr_fl_2_may_depart_inner = yes
	sr_fl_2_leg_months_inner <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_2_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_2_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_2_return_dv_inner }
	}
	sr_fl_2_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_inner multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}

# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_2_ai_attacks_uranus = {
	sr_fl_2_docked = yes
	sr_fl_2_may_depart_uranus = yes
	sr_fl_2_leg_months_uranus <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_uranus = yes
		sr_fl_2_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_2_leg_dv_uranus add = sr_fl_2_return_dv_uranus }
	}
	sr_fl_2_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_uranus multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Neptune system: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_2_ai_attacks_neptune = {
	sr_fl_2_docked = yes
	sr_fl_2_may_depart_neptune = yes
	sr_fl_2_leg_months_neptune <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_neptune = yes
		sr_fl_2_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_2_leg_dv_neptune add = sr_fl_2_return_dv_neptune }
	}
	sr_fl_2_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_neptune multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Kuiper Belt: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_2_ai_attacks_kuiper = {
	sr_fl_2_docked = yes
	sr_fl_2_may_depart_kuiper = yes
	sr_fl_2_leg_months_kuiper <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_kuiper = yes
		sr_fl_2_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_2_leg_dv_kuiper add = sr_fl_2_return_dv_kuiper }
	}
	sr_fl_2_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_kuiper multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}

		var:sr_fl_3_target = 37
		var:sr_fl_3_target = 38
		var:sr_fl_3_target = 39
		var:sr_fl_3_target = 40

sr_fl_3_all_rapid = {
	sr_fl_3_rapid_value > 0
	sr_fl_3_rapid_value >= sr_fl_3_strength
}
sr_fl_3_refitting = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_3_refit_until
	var:sr_fl_3_refit_until > te_history_month_index
}
# Docked: at Earth, or where we hold a world with a Spaceport (design § 2).
sr_fl_3_docked = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_loc_port_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_loc_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_loc_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 sr_loc_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 sr_loc_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 sr_loc_port_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 sr_loc_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 9 sr_loc_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# It refills fully: at Earth, or at a Spaceport on a propellant world of ours.
sr_fl_3_refills_fully = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_loc_propellant_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_loc_propellant_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 sr_loc_propellant_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 sr_loc_propellant_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 sr_loc_propellant_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 9 sr_loc_propellant_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
sr_fl_3_may_depart_earth = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_3_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_3_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_3_dv_value >= sr_fl_3_leg_dv_earth
}
sr_fl_3_may_depart_inner = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_3_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_3_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_3_dv_value >= sr_fl_3_leg_dv_inner
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}
sr_fl_3_may_depart_mars = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_3_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_3_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_3_dv_value >= sr_fl_3_leg_dv_mars
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}

	sr_fl_3_dv_value >= sr_fl_3_leg_dv_asteroids

# 6d: it is at Earth, and nothing may leave Earth (sr_launches_barred).
sr_fl_3_earth_barred = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc
	var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1
	sr_launches_barred = yes
}
# The panel's Go: its picked destination may be flown now.
sr_fl_3_can_go = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_3
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_3 = 1 sr_fl_3_may_depart_earth = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_3 = 2 sr_fl_3_may_depart_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_3 = 3 sr_fl_3_may_depart_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_3 = 4 sr_fl_3_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_3 = 5 sr_fl_3_may_depart_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_3 = 6 sr_fl_3_may_depart_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_3 = 7 sr_fl_3_may_depart_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_3 = 8 sr_fl_3_may_depart_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_3 = 9 sr_fl_3_may_depart_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# Another fleet of ours at the same location, to merge into.
sr_fl_3_can_merge = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_1_loc = var:sr_fl_3_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = var:sr_fl_3_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = var:sr_fl_3_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = var:sr_fl_3_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = var:sr_fl_3_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = var:sr_fl_3_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = var:sr_fl_3_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = var:sr_fl_3_loc }
	}
}
# Strength to halve, and an empty slot to take the half.
sr_fl_3_can_detach = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc
	sr_fl_3_strength >= { value = sr_fl_minimum_strength multiply = 4 }
	sr_fl_has_free_slot = yes
}
# Marines aboard, at a location where we hold a colony; room aboard and
# marines of ours to take back.
sr_fl_3_can_land = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc
	sr_fl_3_marines_value >= 1
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_loc_held_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_loc_held_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_loc_held_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 sr_loc_held_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 sr_loc_held_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 sr_loc_held_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 sr_loc_held_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 9 sr_loc_held_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
sr_fl_3_can_embark = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc
	sr_fl_3_marine_capacity > sr_fl_3_marines_value
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_loc_our_marines_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_loc_our_marines_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_loc_our_marines_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 sr_loc_our_marines_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 sr_loc_our_marines_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 sr_loc_our_marines_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 sr_loc_our_marines_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 9 sr_loc_our_marines_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# 6b: a world at its location it may close in on (at war with its holder or
# occupier, or free); its target is one. At Earth, a lunar world (lunar
# colonization § 8.1).
sr_fl_3_has_hostile_world = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = shackleton } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = peary } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = tranquility } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = marius_hills } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = daedalus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = imbrium } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mercury } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pallas } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hygiea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = io } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = europa } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ganymede } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = callisto } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = himalia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = amalthea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = titan } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = enceladus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = rhea } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mimas } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = iapetus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = titania } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = oberon } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = miranda } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ariel } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = triton } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = proteus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 9 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pluto } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = eris } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = makemake } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = haumea } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = sedna } } }
	}
}
sr_fl_3_target_hostile = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_3_target
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 1 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 2 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 3 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 4 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 5 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 6 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ceres } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 7 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = vesta } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 8 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = psyche } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 9 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pallas } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 10 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hygiea } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 11 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = io } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 12 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = europa } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 13 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ganymede } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 14 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = callisto } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 15 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = himalia } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 16 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = amalthea } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 17 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = venus } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 18 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mercury } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 19 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = titan } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 20 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = enceladus } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 21 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = rhea } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 22 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mimas } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 23 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = iapetus } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 24 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = titania } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 25 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = oberon } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 26 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = miranda } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 27 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ariel } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 28 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = triton } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 29 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = proteus } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 30 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pluto } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 31 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = eris } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 32 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = makemake } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 33 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = haumea } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 34 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = sedna } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 35 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = shackleton } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 36 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = peary } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 37 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = tranquility } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 38 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = marius_hills } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 39 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = daedalus } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_target = 40 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = imbrium } }
	}
}
# 6c: a world at its location it may interdict (a country at peace with us,
# not our ally, holds it); its target is one; it interdicts. Never at Earth
# (lunar colonization § 8.3).
sr_fl_3_has_interdict_world = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mercury } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = pallas } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hygiea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = io } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = europa } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ganymede } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = callisto } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = himalia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = amalthea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = titan } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = enceladus } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = rhea } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mimas } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = iapetus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = titania } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = oberon } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = miranda } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ariel } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = triton } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = proteus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 9 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = pluto } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = eris } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = makemake } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = haumea } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = sedna } } }
	}
}

sr_fl_3_interdicting = { sr_fl_3_posture_value = 4 }
# At Earth, closing in on a lunar world (the AI's offence leaves it there).
sr_fl_3_closing_at_earth = { sr_fl_3_at_earth = yes sr_fl_3_posture_value = 3 }
# The target button: interdicting, the worlds it may interdict; else the
# hostile worlds.
sr_fl_3_can_target = {
	OR = {
		AND = { sr_fl_3_posture_value = 4 sr_fl_3_has_interdict_world = yes }
		AND = { NOT = { sr_fl_3_posture_value = 4 } sr_fl_3_has_hostile_world = yes }
	}
}
# The posture button's next step is Interdict (its price, in the tooltip).
sr_fl_3_next_interdict = {
	sr_fl_3_has_interdict_world = yes
	OR = {
		sr_fl_3_posture_value = 3
		AND = { sr_fl_3_posture_value = 2 NOT = { sr_fl_3_has_hostile_world = yes } }
	}
}
# The AI's: at Earth, or where no world of ours is threatened.
sr_fl_3_ai_free = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc
	NOT = { OR = { AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_fl_ai_threatened_inner = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_fl_ai_threatened_mars = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_fl_ai_threatened_asteroids = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 sr_fl_ai_threatened_jupiter = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 sr_fl_ai_threatened_saturn = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 sr_fl_ai_threatened_uranus = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 sr_fl_ai_threatened_neptune = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 9 sr_fl_ai_threatened_kuiper = yes } } }
}
# It reaches Mercury and Venus within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_3_ai_reaches_inner = {
	OR = {
		sr_fl_3_leg_months_inner <= 6
		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_inner global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_inner >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_3_leg_months_inner } }
	}
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_3_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_3_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_3_return_dv_inner }
	}
}
# It reaches Mars within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_3_ai_reaches_mars = {
	OR = {
		sr_fl_3_leg_months_mars <= 6
		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_mars global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_mars >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_3_leg_months_mars } }
	}
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_mars = yes
		sr_fl_3_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_3_leg_dv_mars add = sr_fl_3_return_dv_mars }
	}
}

# 6c: it may attack Mercury and Venus: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_3_ai_attacks_inner = {
	sr_fl_3_docked = yes
	sr_fl_3_may_depart_inner = yes
	sr_fl_3_leg_months_inner <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_3_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_3_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_3_return_dv_inner }
	}
	sr_fl_3_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_inner multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack Mars: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to

	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_saturn = yes
		sr_fl_3_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_3_leg_dv_saturn add = sr_fl_3_return_dv_saturn }
	}
	sr_fl_3_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_saturn multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Uranus system: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_3_ai_attacks_uranus = {
	sr_fl_3_docked = yes
	sr_fl_3_may_depart_uranus = yes
	sr_fl_3_leg_months_uranus <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_uranus = yes
		sr_fl_3_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_3_leg_dv_uranus add = sr_fl_3_return_dv_uranus }
	}
	sr_fl_3_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_uranus multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Neptune system: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_3_ai_attacks_neptune = {
	sr_fl_3_docked = yes
	sr_fl_3_may_depart_neptune = yes
	sr_fl_3_leg_months_neptune <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_neptune = yes
		sr_fl_3_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_3_leg_dv_neptune add = sr_fl_3_return_dv_neptune }
	}
	sr_fl_3_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_neptune multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Kuiper Belt: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_3_ai_attacks_kuiper = {
	sr_fl_3_docked = yes
	sr_fl_3_may_depart_kuiper = yes
	sr_fl_3_leg_months_kuiper <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_kuiper = yes
		sr_fl_3_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_3_leg_dv_kuiper add = sr_fl_3_return_dv_kuiper }
	}
	sr_fl_3_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_kuiper multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}

# Its target is a lunar world (lunar colonization § 8.1): the only close-in at Earth.

	has_variable = sr_fl_4_target
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_4_target = 35
		var:sr_fl_4_target = 36
		var:sr_fl_4_target = 37
		var:sr_fl_4_target = 38
		var:sr_fl_4_target = 39
		var:sr_fl_4_target = 40
	}
}

sr_fl_4_all_rapid = {
	sr_fl_4_rapid_value > 0
	sr_fl_4_rapid_value >= sr_fl_4_strength
}
sr_fl_4_refitting = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_4_refit_until
	var:sr_fl_4_refit_until > te_history_month_index
}
# Docked: at Earth, or where we hold a world with a Spaceport (design § 2).
sr_fl_4_docked = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_4_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 2 sr_loc_port_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 3 sr_loc_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 4 sr_loc_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 5 sr_loc_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 6 sr_loc_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 7 sr_loc_port_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 8 sr_loc_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 9 sr_loc_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# It refills fully: at Earth, or at a Spaceport on a propellant world of ours.
sr_fl_4_refills_fully = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_4_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 3 sr_loc_propellant_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 4 sr_loc_propellant_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 5 sr_loc_propellant_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 6 sr_loc_propellant_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 8 sr_loc_propellant_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 9 sr_loc_propellant_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
sr_fl_4_may_depart_earth = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 1 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_4_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_4_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_4_dv_value >= sr_fl_4_leg_dv_earth
}
sr_fl_4_may_depart_inner = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 2 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_4_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_4_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_4_dv_value >= sr_fl_4_leg_dv_inner
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}
sr_fl_4_may_depart_mars = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 3 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_4_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_4_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_4_dv_value >= sr_fl_4_leg_dv_mars
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}
sr_fl_4_may_depart_asteroids = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 4 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_4_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_4_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_4_dv_value >= sr_fl_4_leg_dv_asteroids
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}

	sr_fl_4_dv_value >= sr_fl_4_leg_dv_jupiter
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}

	has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc

	sr_fl_4_dv_value >= sr_fl_4_leg_dv_saturn

	has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 9 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_4_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_4_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_4_dv_value >= sr_fl_4_leg_dv_kuiper
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}
# 6d: it is at Earth, and nothing may leave Earth (sr_launches_barred).
sr_fl_4_earth_barred = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc
	var:sr_fl_4_loc = 1
	sr_launches_barred = yes
}
# The panel's Go: its picked destination may be flown now.
sr_fl_4_can_go = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_4
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_4 = 1 sr_fl_4_may_depart_earth = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_4 = 2 sr_fl_4_may_depart_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_4 = 3 sr_fl_4_may_depart_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_4 = 4 sr_fl_4_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_4 = 5 sr_fl_4_may_depart_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_4 = 6 sr_fl_4_may_depart_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_4 = 7 sr_fl_4_may_depart_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_4 = 8 sr_fl_4_may_depart_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_4 = 9 sr_fl_4_may_depart_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# Another fleet of ours at the same location, to merge into.
sr_fl_4_can_merge = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_1_loc = var:sr_fl_4_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = var:sr_fl_4_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = var:sr_fl_4_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = var:sr_fl_4_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = var:sr_fl_4_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = var:sr_fl_4_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = var:sr_fl_4_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = var:sr_fl_4_loc }
	}
}
# Strength to halve, and an empty slot to take the half.
sr_fl_4_can_detach = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc
	sr_fl_4_strength >= { value = sr_fl_minimum_strength multiply = 4 }
	sr_fl_has_free_slot = yes
}
# Marines aboard, at a location where we hold a colony; room aboard and
# marines of ours to take back.
sr_fl_4_can_land = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc
	sr_fl_4_marines_value >= 1
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 2 sr_loc_held_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 3 sr_loc_held_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 4 sr_loc_held_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 5 sr_loc_held_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 6 sr_loc_held_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 7 sr_loc_held_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 8 sr_loc_held_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 9 sr_loc_held_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
sr_fl_4_can_embark = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc
	sr_fl_4_marine_capacity > sr_fl_4_marines_value
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 2 sr_loc_our_marines_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 3 sr_loc_our_marines_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 4 sr_loc_our_marines_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 5 sr_loc_our_marines_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 6 sr_loc_our_marines_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 7 sr_loc_our_marines_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 8 sr_loc_our_marines_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 9 sr_loc_our_marines_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# 6b: a world at its location it may close in on (at war with its holder or
# occupier, or free); its target is one. At Earth, a lunar world (lunar
# colonization § 8.1).
sr_fl_4_has_hostile_world = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 1 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = shackleton } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = peary } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = tranquility } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = marius_hills } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = daedalus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = imbrium } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 2 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mercury } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 3 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 4 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pallas } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hygiea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 5 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = io } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = europa } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ganymede } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = callisto } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = himalia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = amalthea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 6 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = titan } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = enceladus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = rhea } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mimas } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = iapetus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 7 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = titania } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = oberon } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = miranda } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ariel } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 8 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = triton } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = proteus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 9 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pluto } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = eris } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = makemake } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = haumea } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = sedna } } }
	}
}

# 6c: a world at its location it may interdict (a country at peace with us,
# not our ally, holds it); its target is one; it interdicts. Never at Earth
# (lunar colonization § 8.3).
sr_fl_4_has_interdict_world = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 2 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mercury } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 3 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 4 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = pallas } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hygiea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 5 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = io } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = europa } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ganymede } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = callisto } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = himalia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = amalthea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 6 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = titan } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = enceladus } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = rhea } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mimas } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = iapetus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 7 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = titania } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = oberon } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = miranda } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ariel } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 8 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = triton } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = proteus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 9 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = pluto } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = eris } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = makemake } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = haumea } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = sedna } } }

sr_fl_4_interdicting = { sr_fl_4_posture_value = 4 }
# At Earth, closing in on a lunar world (the AI's offence leaves it there).
sr_fl_4_closing_at_earth = { sr_fl_4_at_earth = yes sr_fl_4_posture_value = 3 }
# The target button: interdicting, the worlds it may interdict; else the
# hostile worlds.
sr_fl_4_can_target = {
	OR = {
		AND = { sr_fl_4_posture_value = 4 sr_fl_4_has_interdict_world = yes }
		AND = { NOT = { sr_fl_4_posture_value = 4 } sr_fl_4_has_hostile_world = yes }
	}
}
# The posture button's next step is Interdict (its price, in the tooltip).
sr_fl_4_next_interdict = {
	sr_fl_4_has_interdict_world = yes
	OR = {
		sr_fl_4_posture_value = 3
		AND = { sr_fl_4_posture_value = 2 NOT = { sr_fl_4_has_hostile_world = yes } }
	}
}
# The AI's: at Earth, or where no world of ours is threatened.
sr_fl_4_ai_free = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc
	NOT = { OR = { AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 2 sr_fl_ai_threatened_inner = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 3 sr_fl_ai_threatened_mars = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 4 sr_fl_ai_threatened_asteroids = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 5 sr_fl_ai_threatened_jupiter = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 6 sr_fl_ai_threatened_saturn = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 7 sr_fl_ai_threatened_uranus = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 8 sr_fl_ai_threatened_neptune = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 9 sr_fl_ai_threatened_kuiper = yes } } }
}
# It reaches Mercury and Venus within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_4_ai_reaches_inner = {
	OR = {
		sr_fl_4_leg_months_inner <= 6
		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_inner global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_inner >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_4_leg_months_inner } }
	}
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_4_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_4_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_4_return_dv_inner }
	}
}
# It reaches Mars within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_4_ai_reaches_mars = {
	OR = {
		sr_fl_4_leg_months_mars <= 6
		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_mars global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_mars >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_4_leg_months_mars } }
	}
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_mars = yes
		sr_fl_4_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_4_leg_dv_mars add = sr_fl_4_return_dv_mars }
	}
}

# 6c: it may attack Mercury and Venus: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_4_ai_attacks_inner = {
	sr_fl_4_docked = yes
	sr_fl_4_may_depart_inner = yes
	sr_fl_4_leg_months_inner <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_4_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_4_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_4_return_dv_inner }
	}
	sr_fl_4_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_inner multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}

# 6c: it may attack the Saturn system: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_4_ai_attacks_saturn = {
	sr_fl_4_docked = yes
	sr_fl_4_may_depart_saturn = yes
	sr_fl_4_leg_months_saturn <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_saturn = yes
		sr_fl_4_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_4_leg_dv_saturn add = sr_fl_4_return_dv_saturn }
	}
	sr_fl_4_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_saturn multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Uranus system: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_4_ai_attacks_uranus = {
	sr_fl_4_docked = yes
	sr_fl_4_may_depart_uranus = yes
	sr_fl_4_leg_months_uranus <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_uranus = yes
		sr_fl_4_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_4_leg_dv_uranus add = sr_fl_4_return_dv_uranus }
	}
	sr_fl_4_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_uranus multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Neptune system: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_4_ai_attacks_neptune = {
	sr_fl_4_docked = yes
	sr_fl_4_may_depart_neptune = yes
	sr_fl_4_leg_months_neptune <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_neptune = yes
		sr_fl_4_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_4_leg_dv_neptune add = sr_fl_4_return_dv_neptune }
	}
	sr_fl_4_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_neptune multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Kuiper Belt: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_4_ai_attacks_kuiper = {
	sr_fl_4_docked = yes
	sr_fl_4_may_depart_kuiper = yes
	sr_fl_4_leg_months_kuiper <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_kuiper = yes
		sr_fl_4_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_4_leg_dv_kuiper add = sr_fl_4_return_dv_kuiper }
	}
	sr_fl_4_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_kuiper multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}

# --- Slot 5 ---

# Its target is a lunar world (lunar colonization § 8.1): the only close-in at Earth.

	has_variable = sr_fl_5_target
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_5_target = 35
		var:sr_fl_5_target = 36
		var:sr_fl_5_target = 37
		var:sr_fl_5_target = 38
		var:sr_fl_5_target = 39
		var:sr_fl_5_target = 40
	}
}

sr_fl_5_all_rapid = {
	sr_fl_5_rapid_value > 0
	sr_fl_5_rapid_value >= sr_fl_5_strength
}
sr_fl_5_refitting = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_5_refit_until
	var:sr_fl_5_refit_until > te_history_month_index
}
# Docked: at Earth, or where we hold a world with a Spaceport (design § 2).
sr_fl_5_docked = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_5_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 2 sr_loc_port_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 3 sr_loc_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 4 sr_loc_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 5 sr_loc_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 6 sr_loc_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 7 sr_loc_port_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 8 sr_loc_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 9 sr_loc_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# It refills fully: at Earth, or at a Spaceport on a propellant world of ours.
sr_fl_5_refills_fully = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_5_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 3 sr_loc_propellant_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 4 sr_loc_propellant_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 5 sr_loc_propellant_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 6 sr_loc_propellant_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 8 sr_loc_propellant_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 9 sr_loc_propellant_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
sr_fl_5_may_depart_earth = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 1 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_5_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_5_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_5_dv_value >= sr_fl_5_leg_dv_earth
}
sr_fl_5_may_depart_inner = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 2 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_5_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_5_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_5_dv_value >= sr_fl_5_leg_dv_inner
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}
sr_fl_5_may_depart_mars = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 3 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_5_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_5_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_5_dv_value >= sr_fl_5_leg_dv_mars
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}
sr_fl_5_may_depart_asteroids = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 4 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_5_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_5_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_5_dv_value >= sr_fl_5_leg_dv_asteroids
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}

# 6d: it is at Earth, and nothing may leave Earth (sr_launches_barred).
sr_fl_5_earth_barred = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc
	var:sr_fl_5_loc = 1
	sr_launches_barred = yes
}
# The panel's Go: its picked destination may be flown now.
sr_fl_5_can_go = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_5
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_5 = 1 sr_fl_5_may_depart_earth = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_5 = 2 sr_fl_5_may_depart_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_5 = 3 sr_fl_5_may_depart_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_5 = 4 sr_fl_5_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_5 = 5 sr_fl_5_may_depart_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_5 = 6 sr_fl_5_may_depart_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_5 = 7 sr_fl_5_may_depart_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_5 = 8 sr_fl_5_may_depart_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_5 = 9 sr_fl_5_may_depart_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# Another fleet of ours at the same location, to merge into.
sr_fl_5_can_merge = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_1_loc = var:sr_fl_5_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = var:sr_fl_5_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = var:sr_fl_5_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = var:sr_fl_5_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = var:sr_fl_5_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = var:sr_fl_5_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = var:sr_fl_5_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = var:sr_fl_5_loc }
	}
}
# Strength to halve, and an empty slot to take the half.
sr_fl_5_can_detach = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc
	sr_fl_5_strength >= { value = sr_fl_minimum_strength multiply = 4 }
	sr_fl_has_free_slot = yes
}
# Marines aboard, at a location where we hold a colony; room aboard and
# marines of ours to take back.
sr_fl_5_can_land = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc
	sr_fl_5_marines_value >= 1
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 2 sr_loc_held_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 3 sr_loc_held_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 4 sr_loc_held_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 5 sr_loc_held_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 6 sr_loc_held_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 7 sr_loc_held_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 8 sr_loc_held_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 9 sr_loc_held_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
sr_fl_5_can_embark = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc
	sr_fl_5_marine_capacity > sr_fl_5_marines_value
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 2 sr_loc_our_marines_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 3 sr_loc_our_marines_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 4 sr_loc_our_marines_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 5 sr_loc_our_marines_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 6 sr_loc_our_marines_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 7 sr_loc_our_marines_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 8 sr_loc_our_marines_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 9 sr_loc_our_marines_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# 6b: a world at its location it may close in on (at war with its holder or
# occupier, or free); its target is one. At Earth, a lunar world (lunar
# colonization § 8.1).
sr_fl_5_has_hostile_world = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 1 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = shackleton } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = peary } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = tranquility } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = marius_hills } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = daedalus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = imbrium } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 2 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mercury } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 3 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 4 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pallas } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hygiea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 5 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = io } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = europa } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ganymede } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = callisto } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = himalia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = amalthea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 6 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = titan } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = enceladus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = rhea } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mimas } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = iapetus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 7 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = titania } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = oberon } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = miranda } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ariel } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 8 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = triton } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = proteus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 9 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pluto } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = eris } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = makemake } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = haumea } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = sedna } } }
	}
}

# 6c: a world at its location it may interdict (a country at peace with us,
# not our ally, holds it); its target is one; it interdicts. Never at Earth
# (lunar colonization § 8.3).
sr_fl_5_has_interdict_world = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 2 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mercury } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 3 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 4 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = pallas } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hygiea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 5 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = io } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = europa } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ganymede } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = callisto } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = himalia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = amalthea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 6 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = titan } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = enceladus } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = rhea } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mimas } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = iapetus } } }

sr_fl_5_interdicting = { sr_fl_5_posture_value = 4 }
# At Earth, closing in on a lunar world (the AI's offence leaves it there).
sr_fl_5_closing_at_earth = { sr_fl_5_at_earth = yes sr_fl_5_posture_value = 3 }
# The target button: interdicting, the worlds it may interdict; else the
# hostile worlds.
sr_fl_5_can_target = {
	OR = {
		AND = { sr_fl_5_posture_value = 4 sr_fl_5_has_interdict_world = yes }
		AND = { NOT = { sr_fl_5_posture_value = 4 } sr_fl_5_has_hostile_world = yes }
	}
}
# The posture button's next step is Interdict (its price, in the tooltip).
sr_fl_5_next_interdict = {
	sr_fl_5_has_interdict_world = yes
	OR = {
		sr_fl_5_posture_value = 3
		AND = { sr_fl_5_posture_value = 2 NOT = { sr_fl_5_has_hostile_world = yes } }
	}
}
# The AI's: at Earth, or where no world of ours is threatened.
sr_fl_5_ai_free = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc
	NOT = { OR = { AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 2 sr_fl_ai_threatened_inner = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 3 sr_fl_ai_threatened_mars = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 4 sr_fl_ai_threatened_asteroids = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 5 sr_fl_ai_threatened_jupiter = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 6 sr_fl_ai_threatened_saturn = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 7 sr_fl_ai_threatened_uranus = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 8 sr_fl_ai_threatened_neptune = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_5_loc = 9 sr_fl_ai_threatened_kuiper = yes } } }
}
# It reaches Mercury and Venus within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_5_ai_reaches_inner = {
	OR = {
		sr_fl_5_leg_months_inner <= 6
		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_inner global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_inner >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_5_leg_months_inner } }
	}
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_5_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_5_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_5_return_dv_inner }
	}
}
# It reaches Mars within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_5_ai_reaches_mars = {
	OR = {
		sr_fl_5_leg_months_mars <= 6
		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_mars global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_mars >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_5_leg_months_mars } }

	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_mars = yes
		sr_fl_5_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_5_leg_dv_mars add = sr_fl_5_return_dv_mars }
	}
}

# 6c: it may attack Mercury and Venus: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_5_ai_attacks_inner = {
	sr_fl_5_docked = yes
	sr_fl_5_may_depart_inner = yes
	sr_fl_5_leg_months_inner <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_5_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_5_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_5_return_dv_inner }
	}
	sr_fl_5_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_inner multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack Mars: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to

	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_jupiter = yes
		sr_fl_5_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_5_leg_dv_jupiter add = sr_fl_5_return_dv_jupiter }
	}
	sr_fl_5_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_jupiter multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Saturn system: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_5_ai_attacks_saturn = {
	sr_fl_5_docked = yes
	sr_fl_5_may_depart_saturn = yes
	sr_fl_5_leg_months_saturn <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_saturn = yes
		sr_fl_5_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_5_leg_dv_saturn add = sr_fl_5_return_dv_saturn }
	}
	sr_fl_5_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_saturn multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Uranus system: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to

# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there

}

		var:sr_fl_6_target = 36
		var:sr_fl_6_target = 37
		var:sr_fl_6_target = 38
		var:sr_fl_6_target = 39
		var:sr_fl_6_target = 40

sr_fl_6_all_rapid = {
	sr_fl_6_rapid_value > 0
	sr_fl_6_rapid_value >= sr_fl_6_strength
}
sr_fl_6_refitting = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_6_refit_until
	var:sr_fl_6_refit_until > te_history_month_index
}
# Docked: at Earth, or where we hold a world with a Spaceport (design § 2).
sr_fl_6_docked = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_6_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 2 sr_loc_port_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 3 sr_loc_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 4 sr_loc_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 5 sr_loc_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 6 sr_loc_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 7 sr_loc_port_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 8 sr_loc_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 9 sr_loc_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# It refills fully: at Earth, or at a Spaceport on a propellant world of ours.
sr_fl_6_refills_fully = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_6_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 3 sr_loc_propellant_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 4 sr_loc_propellant_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 5 sr_loc_propellant_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 6 sr_loc_propellant_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 8 sr_loc_propellant_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 9 sr_loc_propellant_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
sr_fl_6_may_depart_earth = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 1 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_6_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_6_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_6_dv_value >= sr_fl_6_leg_dv_earth
}
sr_fl_6_may_depart_inner = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 2 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_6_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_6_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_6_dv_value >= sr_fl_6_leg_dv_inner
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}
sr_fl_6_may_depart_mars = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 3 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_6_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_6_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_6_dv_value >= sr_fl_6_leg_dv_mars
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}

	sr_fl_6_dv_value >= sr_fl_6_leg_dv_asteroids

# 6d: it is at Earth, and nothing may leave Earth (sr_launches_barred).
sr_fl_6_earth_barred = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc
	var:sr_fl_6_loc = 1
	sr_launches_barred = yes
}
# The panel's Go: its picked destination may be flown now.
sr_fl_6_can_go = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_6
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_6 = 1 sr_fl_6_may_depart_earth = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_6 = 2 sr_fl_6_may_depart_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_6 = 3 sr_fl_6_may_depart_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_6 = 4 sr_fl_6_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_6 = 5 sr_fl_6_may_depart_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_6 = 6 sr_fl_6_may_depart_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_6 = 7 sr_fl_6_may_depart_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_6 = 8 sr_fl_6_may_depart_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_6 = 9 sr_fl_6_may_depart_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# Another fleet of ours at the same location, to merge into.
sr_fl_6_can_merge = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_1_loc = var:sr_fl_6_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = var:sr_fl_6_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = var:sr_fl_6_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = var:sr_fl_6_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = var:sr_fl_6_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = var:sr_fl_6_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = var:sr_fl_6_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = var:sr_fl_6_loc }
	}
}
# Strength to halve, and an empty slot to take the half.
sr_fl_6_can_detach = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc
	sr_fl_6_strength >= { value = sr_fl_minimum_strength multiply = 4 }
	sr_fl_has_free_slot = yes
}
# Marines aboard, at a location where we hold a colony; room aboard and
# marines of ours to take back.
sr_fl_6_can_land = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc
	sr_fl_6_marines_value >= 1
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 2 sr_loc_held_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 3 sr_loc_held_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 4 sr_loc_held_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 5 sr_loc_held_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 6 sr_loc_held_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 7 sr_loc_held_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 8 sr_loc_held_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 9 sr_loc_held_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
sr_fl_6_can_embark = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc
	sr_fl_6_marine_capacity > sr_fl_6_marines_value
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 2 sr_loc_our_marines_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 3 sr_loc_our_marines_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 4 sr_loc_our_marines_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 5 sr_loc_our_marines_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 6 sr_loc_our_marines_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 7 sr_loc_our_marines_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 8 sr_loc_our_marines_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 9 sr_loc_our_marines_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# 6b: a world at its location it may close in on (at war with its holder or
# occupier, or free); its target is one. At Earth, a lunar world (lunar
# colonization § 8.1).
sr_fl_6_has_hostile_world = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 1 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = shackleton } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = peary } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = tranquility } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = marius_hills } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = daedalus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = imbrium } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 2 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mercury } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 3 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 4 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pallas } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hygiea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 5 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = io } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = europa } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ganymede } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = callisto } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = himalia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = amalthea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 6 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = titan } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = enceladus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = rhea } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mimas } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = iapetus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 7 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = titania } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = oberon } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = miranda } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ariel } } }

		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 9 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pluto } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = eris } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = makemake } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = haumea } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = sedna } } }
	}

# 6c: a world at its location it may interdict (a country at peace with us,
# not our ally, holds it); its target is one; it interdicts. Never at Earth
# (lunar colonization § 8.3).
sr_fl_6_has_interdict_world = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 2 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mercury } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 3 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 4 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = pallas } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hygiea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 5 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = io } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = europa } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ganymede } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = callisto } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = himalia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = amalthea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 6 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = titan } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = enceladus } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = rhea } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mimas } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = iapetus } } }

sr_fl_6_interdicting = { sr_fl_6_posture_value = 4 }
# At Earth, closing in on a lunar world (the AI's offence leaves it there).
sr_fl_6_closing_at_earth = { sr_fl_6_at_earth = yes sr_fl_6_posture_value = 3 }
# The target button: interdicting, the worlds it may interdict; else the
# hostile worlds.
sr_fl_6_can_target = {
	OR = {
		AND = { sr_fl_6_posture_value = 4 sr_fl_6_has_interdict_world = yes }
		AND = { NOT = { sr_fl_6_posture_value = 4 } sr_fl_6_has_hostile_world = yes }
	}
}
# The posture button's next step is Interdict (its price, in the tooltip).
sr_fl_6_next_interdict = {
	sr_fl_6_has_interdict_world = yes
	OR = {
		sr_fl_6_posture_value = 3
		AND = { sr_fl_6_posture_value = 2 NOT = { sr_fl_6_has_hostile_world = yes } }
	}
}
# The AI's: at Earth, or where no world of ours is threatened.
sr_fl_6_ai_free = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc
	NOT = { OR = { AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 2 sr_fl_ai_threatened_inner = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 3 sr_fl_ai_threatened_mars = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 4 sr_fl_ai_threatened_asteroids = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 5 sr_fl_ai_threatened_jupiter = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 6 sr_fl_ai_threatened_saturn = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 7 sr_fl_ai_threatened_uranus = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 8 sr_fl_ai_threatened_neptune = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_6_loc = 9 sr_fl_ai_threatened_kuiper = yes } } }
}
# It reaches Mercury and Venus within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_6_ai_reaches_inner = {
	OR = {
		sr_fl_6_leg_months_inner <= 6
		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_inner global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_inner >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_6_leg_months_inner } }
	}
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_6_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_6_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_6_return_dv_inner }
	}
}
# It reaches Mars within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_6_ai_reaches_mars = {

		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_mars global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_mars >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_6_leg_months_mars } }

		sr_loc_port_mars = yes

	}
}
