# 6c: it may attack Mercury and Venus: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_6_ai_attacks_inner = {
	sr_fl_6_docked = yes
	sr_fl_6_may_depart_inner = yes
	sr_fl_6_leg_months_inner <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_6_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_6_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_6_return_dv_inner }
	}
	sr_fl_6_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_inner multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack Mars: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to

# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_6_ai_attacks_jupiter = {
	sr_fl_6_docked = yes
	sr_fl_6_may_depart_jupiter = yes
	sr_fl_6_leg_months_jupiter <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_jupiter = yes
		sr_fl_6_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_6_leg_dv_jupiter add = sr_fl_6_return_dv_jupiter }
	}
	sr_fl_6_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_jupiter multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Saturn system: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_6_ai_attacks_saturn = {
	sr_fl_6_docked = yes
	sr_fl_6_may_depart_saturn = yes
	sr_fl_6_leg_months_saturn <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_saturn = yes
		sr_fl_6_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_6_leg_dv_saturn add = sr_fl_6_return_dv_saturn }
	}
	sr_fl_6_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_saturn multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}

# Its target is a lunar world (lunar colonization § 8.1): the only close-in at Earth.

	has_variable = sr_fl_7_target
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_7_target = 35
		var:sr_fl_7_target = 36
		var:sr_fl_7_target = 37
		var:sr_fl_7_target = 38
		var:sr_fl_7_target = 39
		var:sr_fl_7_target = 40
	}
}

sr_fl_7_all_rapid = {
	sr_fl_7_rapid_value > 0
	sr_fl_7_rapid_value >= sr_fl_7_strength
}
sr_fl_7_refitting = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_7_refit_until
	var:sr_fl_7_refit_until > te_history_month_index
}
# Docked: at Earth, or where we hold a world with a Spaceport (design § 2).
sr_fl_7_docked = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_7_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 2 sr_loc_port_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 3 sr_loc_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 4 sr_loc_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 5 sr_loc_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 6 sr_loc_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 7 sr_loc_port_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 8 sr_loc_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 9 sr_loc_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# It refills fully: at Earth, or at a Spaceport on a propellant world of ours.
sr_fl_7_refills_fully = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_7_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 3 sr_loc_propellant_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 4 sr_loc_propellant_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 5 sr_loc_propellant_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 6 sr_loc_propellant_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 8 sr_loc_propellant_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 9 sr_loc_propellant_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
sr_fl_7_may_depart_earth = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 1 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_7_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_7_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_7_dv_value >= sr_fl_7_leg_dv_earth
}
sr_fl_7_may_depart_inner = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 2 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_7_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_7_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_7_dv_value >= sr_fl_7_leg_dv_inner
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}
sr_fl_7_may_depart_mars = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 3 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_7_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_7_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_7_dv_value >= sr_fl_7_leg_dv_mars
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}

	sr_fl_7_dv_value >= sr_fl_7_leg_dv_asteroids

# 6d: it is at Earth, and nothing may leave Earth (sr_launches_barred).
sr_fl_7_earth_barred = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc
	var:sr_fl_7_loc = 1
	sr_launches_barred = yes
}
# The panel's Go: its picked destination may be flown now.
sr_fl_7_can_go = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_7
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_7 = 1 sr_fl_7_may_depart_earth = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_7 = 2 sr_fl_7_may_depart_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_7 = 3 sr_fl_7_may_depart_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_7 = 4 sr_fl_7_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_7 = 5 sr_fl_7_may_depart_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_7 = 6 sr_fl_7_may_depart_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_7 = 7 sr_fl_7_may_depart_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_7 = 8 sr_fl_7_may_depart_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_7 = 9 sr_fl_7_may_depart_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# Another fleet of ours at the same location, to merge into.
sr_fl_7_can_merge = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_1_loc = var:sr_fl_7_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = var:sr_fl_7_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = var:sr_fl_7_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = var:sr_fl_7_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = var:sr_fl_7_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = var:sr_fl_7_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = var:sr_fl_7_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = var:sr_fl_7_loc }
	}
}
# Strength to halve, and an empty slot to take the half.
sr_fl_7_can_detach = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc
	sr_fl_7_strength >= { value = sr_fl_minimum_strength multiply = 4 }
	sr_fl_has_free_slot = yes
}
# Marines aboard, at a location where we hold a colony; room aboard and
# marines of ours to take back.
sr_fl_7_can_land = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc
	sr_fl_7_marines_value >= 1
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 2 sr_loc_held_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 3 sr_loc_held_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 4 sr_loc_held_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 5 sr_loc_held_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 6 sr_loc_held_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 7 sr_loc_held_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 8 sr_loc_held_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 9 sr_loc_held_kuiper = yes }
	}
}

	sr_fl_7_marine_capacity > sr_fl_7_marines_value
	OR = {

		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 3 sr_loc_our_marines_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 4 sr_loc_our_marines_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 5 sr_loc_our_marines_jupiter = yes }

# 6b: a world at its location it may close in on (at war with its holder or
# occupier, or free); its target is one. At Earth, a lunar world (lunar
# colonization § 8.1).
sr_fl_7_has_hostile_world = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 1 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = shackleton } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = peary } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = tranquility } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = marius_hills } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = daedalus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = imbrium } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 2 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mercury } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 3 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 4 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pallas } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hygiea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 5 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = io } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = europa } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ganymede } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = callisto } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = himalia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = amalthea } } }

# 6c: a world at its location it may interdict (a country at peace with us,
# not our ally, holds it); its target is one; it interdicts. Never at Earth
# (lunar colonization § 8.3).
sr_fl_7_has_interdict_world = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 2 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mercury } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 3 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 4 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = pallas } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hygiea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 5 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = io } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = europa } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ganymede } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = callisto } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = himalia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = amalthea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 6 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = titan } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = enceladus } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = rhea } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mimas } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = iapetus } } }

sr_fl_7_interdicting = { sr_fl_7_posture_value = 4 }
# At Earth, closing in on a lunar world (the AI's offence leaves it there).
sr_fl_7_closing_at_earth = { sr_fl_7_at_earth = yes sr_fl_7_posture_value = 3 }
# The target button: interdicting, the worlds it may interdict; else the
# hostile worlds.
sr_fl_7_can_target = {
	OR = {
		AND = { sr_fl_7_posture_value = 4 sr_fl_7_has_interdict_world = yes }
		AND = { NOT = { sr_fl_7_posture_value = 4 } sr_fl_7_has_hostile_world = yes }
	}
}
# The posture button's next step is Interdict (its price, in the tooltip).
sr_fl_7_next_interdict = {
	sr_fl_7_has_interdict_world = yes
	OR = {
		sr_fl_7_posture_value = 3
		AND = { sr_fl_7_posture_value = 2 NOT = { sr_fl_7_has_hostile_world = yes } }
	}
}
# The AI's: at Earth, or where no world of ours is threatened.
sr_fl_7_ai_free = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc
	NOT = { OR = { AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 2 sr_fl_ai_threatened_inner = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 3 sr_fl_ai_threatened_mars = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 4 sr_fl_ai_threatened_asteroids = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 5 sr_fl_ai_threatened_jupiter = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 6 sr_fl_ai_threatened_saturn = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 7 sr_fl_ai_threatened_uranus = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 8 sr_fl_ai_threatened_neptune = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 9 sr_fl_ai_threatened_kuiper = yes } } }
}
# It reaches Mercury and Venus within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_7_ai_reaches_inner = {
	OR = {
		sr_fl_7_leg_months_inner <= 6
		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_inner global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_inner >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_7_leg_months_inner } }
	}
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_7_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_7_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_7_return_dv_inner }
	}
}
# It reaches Mars within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_7_ai_reaches_mars = {
	OR = {
		sr_fl_7_leg_months_mars <= 6
		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_mars global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_mars >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_7_leg_months_mars } }
	}
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_mars = yes
		sr_fl_7_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_7_leg_dv_mars add = sr_fl_7_return_dv_mars }
	}
}

# 6c: it may attack Mercury and Venus: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_7_ai_attacks_inner = {
	sr_fl_7_docked = yes
	sr_fl_7_may_depart_inner = yes
	sr_fl_7_leg_months_inner <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_7_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_7_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_7_return_dv_inner }
	}
	sr_fl_7_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_inner multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack Mars: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_7_ai_attacks_mars = {
	sr_fl_7_docked = yes
	sr_fl_7_may_depart_mars = yes
	sr_fl_7_leg_months_mars <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_mars = yes
		sr_fl_7_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_7_leg_dv_mars add = sr_fl_7_return_dv_mars }
	}
	sr_fl_7_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_mars multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Asteroid Belt: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_7_ai_attacks_asteroids = {
	sr_fl_7_docked = yes
	sr_fl_7_may_depart_asteroids = yes
	sr_fl_7_leg_months_asteroids <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_asteroids = yes
		sr_fl_7_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_7_leg_dv_asteroids add = sr_fl_7_return_dv_asteroids }
	}
	sr_fl_7_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_asteroids multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Jupiter system: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_7_ai_attacks_jupiter = {
	sr_fl_7_docked = yes
	sr_fl_7_may_depart_jupiter = yes
	sr_fl_7_leg_months_jupiter <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_jupiter = yes
		sr_fl_7_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_7_leg_dv_jupiter add = sr_fl_7_return_dv_jupiter }
	}
	sr_fl_7_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_jupiter multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}

		var:sr_fl_8_target = 37
		var:sr_fl_8_target = 38

sr_fl_8_all_rapid = {
	sr_fl_8_rapid_value > 0
	sr_fl_8_rapid_value >= sr_fl_8_strength
}
sr_fl_8_refitting = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_8_refit_until
	var:sr_fl_8_refit_until > te_history_month_index
}
# Docked: at Earth, or where we hold a world with a Spaceport (design § 2).
sr_fl_8_docked = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_8_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 sr_loc_port_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 sr_loc_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 4 sr_loc_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 5 sr_loc_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 6 sr_loc_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 7 sr_loc_port_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 8 sr_loc_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 9 sr_loc_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# It refills fully: at Earth, or at a Spaceport on a propellant world of ours.
sr_fl_8_refills_fully = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_8_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 sr_loc_propellant_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 4 sr_loc_propellant_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 5 sr_loc_propellant_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 6 sr_loc_propellant_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 8 sr_loc_propellant_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 9 sr_loc_propellant_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
sr_fl_8_may_depart_earth = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 1 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_8_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_8_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_8_dv_value >= sr_fl_8_leg_dv_earth
}
sr_fl_8_may_depart_inner = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_8_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_8_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_8_dv_value >= sr_fl_8_leg_dv_inner
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}
sr_fl_8_may_depart_mars = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_8_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_8_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_8_dv_value >= sr_fl_8_leg_dv_mars
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}

# 6d: it is at Earth, and nothing may leave Earth (sr_launches_barred).
sr_fl_8_earth_barred = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc
	var:sr_fl_8_loc = 1
	sr_launches_barred = yes
}
# The panel's Go: its picked destination may be flown now.
sr_fl_8_can_go = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_8
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_8 = 1 sr_fl_8_may_depart_earth = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_8 = 2 sr_fl_8_may_depart_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_8 = 3 sr_fl_8_may_depart_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_8 = 4 sr_fl_8_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_8 = 5 sr_fl_8_may_depart_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_8 = 6 sr_fl_8_may_depart_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_8 = 7 sr_fl_8_may_depart_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_8 = 8 sr_fl_8_may_depart_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_8 = 9 sr_fl_8_may_depart_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# Another fleet of ours at the same location, to merge into.
sr_fl_8_can_merge = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_1_loc = var:sr_fl_8_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = var:sr_fl_8_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = var:sr_fl_8_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = var:sr_fl_8_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = var:sr_fl_8_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = var:sr_fl_8_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = var:sr_fl_8_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = var:sr_fl_8_loc }
	}
}
# Strength to halve, and an empty slot to take the half.
sr_fl_8_can_detach = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc
	sr_fl_8_strength >= { value = sr_fl_minimum_strength multiply = 4 }
	sr_fl_has_free_slot = yes
}
# Marines aboard, at a location where we hold a colony; room aboard and
# marines of ours to take back.
sr_fl_8_can_land = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc
	sr_fl_8_marines_value >= 1
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 sr_loc_held_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 sr_loc_held_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 4 sr_loc_held_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 5 sr_loc_held_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 6 sr_loc_held_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 7 sr_loc_held_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 8 sr_loc_held_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 9 sr_loc_held_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
sr_fl_8_can_embark = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc
	sr_fl_8_marine_capacity > sr_fl_8_marines_value
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 sr_loc_our_marines_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 sr_loc_our_marines_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 4 sr_loc_our_marines_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 5 sr_loc_our_marines_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 6 sr_loc_our_marines_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 7 sr_loc_our_marines_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 8 sr_loc_our_marines_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 9 sr_loc_our_marines_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# 6b: a world at its location it may close in on (at war with its holder or
# occupier, or free); its target is one. At Earth, a lunar world (lunar
# colonization § 8.1).
sr_fl_8_has_hostile_world = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 1 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = shackleton } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = peary } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = tranquility } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = marius_hills } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = daedalus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = imbrium } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mercury } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 4 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pallas } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hygiea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 5 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = io } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = europa } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ganymede } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = callisto } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = himalia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = amalthea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 6 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = titan } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = enceladus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = rhea } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mimas } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = iapetus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 7 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = titania } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = oberon } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = miranda } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ariel } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 8 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = triton } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = proteus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 9 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pluto } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = eris } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = makemake } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = haumea } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = sedna } } }
	}
}
sr_fl_8_target_hostile = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_8_target
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 1 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 2 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 3 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 4 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 5 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 6 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ceres } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 7 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = vesta } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 8 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = psyche } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 9 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pallas } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 10 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hygiea } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 11 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = io } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 12 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = europa } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 13 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ganymede } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 14 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = callisto } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 15 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = himalia } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 16 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = amalthea } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 17 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = venus } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 18 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mercury } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 19 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = titan } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 20 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = enceladus } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 21 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = rhea } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 22 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mimas } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 23 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = iapetus } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 24 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = titania } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 25 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = oberon } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 26 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = miranda } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 27 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ariel } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 28 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = triton } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 29 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = proteus } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 30 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pluto } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 31 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = eris } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 32 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = makemake } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 33 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = haumea } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 34 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = sedna } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 35 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = shackleton } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 36 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = peary } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 37 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = tranquility } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 38 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = marius_hills } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 39 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = daedalus } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_target = 40 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = imbrium } }
	}
}
# 6c: a world at its location it may interdict (a country at peace with us,
# not our ally, holds it); its target is one; it interdicts. Never at Earth
# (lunar colonization § 8.3).
sr_fl_8_has_interdict_world = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mercury } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 4 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = pallas } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hygiea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 5 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = io } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = europa } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ganymede } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = callisto } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = himalia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = amalthea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 6 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = titan } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = enceladus } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = rhea } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mimas } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = iapetus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 7 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = titania } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = oberon } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = miranda } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ariel } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 8 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = triton } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = proteus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 9 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = pluto } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = eris } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = makemake } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = haumea } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = sedna } } }
	}
}

sr_fl_8_interdicting = { sr_fl_8_posture_value = 4 }
# At Earth, closing in on a lunar world (the AI's offence leaves it there).
sr_fl_8_closing_at_earth = { sr_fl_8_at_earth = yes sr_fl_8_posture_value = 3 }
# The target button: interdicting, the worlds it may interdict; else the
# hostile worlds.
sr_fl_8_can_target = {
	OR = {
		AND = { sr_fl_8_posture_value = 4 sr_fl_8_has_interdict_world = yes }
		AND = { NOT = { sr_fl_8_posture_value = 4 } sr_fl_8_has_hostile_world = yes }
	}
}
# The posture button's next step is Interdict (its price, in the tooltip).
sr_fl_8_next_interdict = {
	sr_fl_8_has_interdict_world = yes
	OR = {
		sr_fl_8_posture_value = 3
		AND = { sr_fl_8_posture_value = 2 NOT = { sr_fl_8_has_hostile_world = yes } }
	}
}
# The AI's: at Earth, or where no world of ours is threatened.
sr_fl_8_ai_free = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc
	NOT = { OR = { AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 sr_fl_ai_threatened_inner = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 sr_fl_ai_threatened_mars = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 4 sr_fl_ai_threatened_asteroids = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 5 sr_fl_ai_threatened_jupiter = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 6 sr_fl_ai_threatened_saturn = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 7 sr_fl_ai_threatened_uranus = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 8 sr_fl_ai_threatened_neptune = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 9 sr_fl_ai_threatened_kuiper = yes } } }
}
# It reaches Mercury and Venus within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_8_ai_reaches_inner = {
	OR = {
		sr_fl_8_leg_months_inner <= 6
		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_inner global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_inner >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_8_leg_months_inner } }
	}
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_8_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_8_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_8_return_dv_inner }
	}
}
# It reaches Mars within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_8_ai_reaches_mars = {
	OR = {
		sr_fl_8_leg_months_mars <= 6
		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_mars global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_mars >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_8_leg_months_mars } }
	}
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_mars = yes
		sr_fl_8_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_8_leg_dv_mars add = sr_fl_8_return_dv_mars }
	}
}
# It reaches the Asteroid Belt within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can

		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_asteroids global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_asteroids >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_8_leg_months_asteroids } }

		sr_loc_port_asteroids = yes

}

# 6c: it may attack Mercury and Venus: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_8_ai_attacks_inner = {
	sr_fl_8_docked = yes
	sr_fl_8_may_depart_inner = yes
	sr_fl_8_leg_months_inner <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_8_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_8_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_8_return_dv_inner }
	}
	sr_fl_8_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_inner multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack Mars: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_8_ai_attacks_mars = {
	sr_fl_8_docked = yes
	sr_fl_8_may_depart_mars = yes
	sr_fl_8_leg_months_mars <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_mars = yes
		sr_fl_8_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_8_leg_dv_mars add = sr_fl_8_return_dv_mars }
	}
	sr_fl_8_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_mars multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Asteroid Belt: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_8_ai_attacks_asteroids = {
	sr_fl_8_docked = yes
	sr_fl_8_may_depart_asteroids = yes
	sr_fl_8_leg_months_asteroids <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_asteroids = yes
		sr_fl_8_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_8_leg_dv_asteroids add = sr_fl_8_return_dv_asteroids }
	}
	sr_fl_8_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_asteroids multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Jupiter system: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_8_ai_attacks_jupiter = {
	sr_fl_8_docked = yes
	sr_fl_8_may_depart_jupiter = yes
	sr_fl_8_leg_months_jupiter <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_jupiter = yes

}

		var:sr_fl_9_target = 37
		var:sr_fl_9_target = 38
		var:sr_fl_9_target = 39
		var:sr_fl_9_target = 40
	}

sr_fl_9_all_rapid = {
	sr_fl_9_rapid_value > 0
	sr_fl_9_rapid_value >= sr_fl_9_strength
}
sr_fl_9_refitting = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_9_refit_until
	var:sr_fl_9_refit_until > te_history_month_index
}
# Docked: at Earth, or where we hold a world with a Spaceport (design § 2).
sr_fl_9_docked = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_9_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 2 sr_loc_port_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 3 sr_loc_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 4 sr_loc_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 5 sr_loc_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 6 sr_loc_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 7 sr_loc_port_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 8 sr_loc_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 9 sr_loc_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# It refills fully: at Earth, or at a Spaceport on a propellant world of ours.
sr_fl_9_refills_fully = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc
	OR = {
		var:sr_fl_9_loc = 1
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 3 sr_loc_propellant_port_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 4 sr_loc_propellant_port_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 5 sr_loc_propellant_port_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 6 sr_loc_propellant_port_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 8 sr_loc_propellant_port_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 9 sr_loc_propellant_port_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
sr_fl_9_may_depart_earth = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 1 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_9_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_9_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_9_dv_value >= sr_fl_9_leg_dv_earth
}
sr_fl_9_may_depart_inner = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 2 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_9_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_9_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_9_dv_value >= sr_fl_9_leg_dv_inner
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}
sr_fl_9_may_depart_mars = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc
	NOT = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 3 }
	NOT = { sr_fl_9_refitting = yes }
	sr_fl_9_strength >= sr_fl_minimum_strength
	sr_fl_9_dv_value >= sr_fl_9_leg_dv_mars
	NOT = { AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 1 sr_launches_barred = yes } }
}

# 6d: it is at Earth, and nothing may leave Earth (sr_launches_barred).
sr_fl_9_earth_barred = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc
	var:sr_fl_9_loc = 1
	sr_launches_barred = yes
}
# The panel's Go: its picked destination may be flown now.
sr_fl_9_can_go = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_9
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_9 = 1 sr_fl_9_may_depart_earth = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_9 = 2 sr_fl_9_may_depart_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_9 = 3 sr_fl_9_may_depart_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_9 = 4 sr_fl_9_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_9 = 5 sr_fl_9_may_depart_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_9 = 6 sr_fl_9_may_depart_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_9 = 7 sr_fl_9_may_depart_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_9 = 8 sr_fl_9_may_depart_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_dest_pick_9 = 9 sr_fl_9_may_depart_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# Another fleet of ours at the same location, to merge into.
sr_fl_9_can_merge = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_1_loc = var:sr_fl_9_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = var:sr_fl_9_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = var:sr_fl_9_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = var:sr_fl_9_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = var:sr_fl_9_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = var:sr_fl_9_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = var:sr_fl_9_loc }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = var:sr_fl_9_loc }
	}
}
# Strength to halve, and an empty slot to take the half.
sr_fl_9_can_detach = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc
	sr_fl_9_strength >= { value = sr_fl_minimum_strength multiply = 4 }
	sr_fl_has_free_slot = yes
}
# Marines aboard, at a location where we hold a colony; room aboard and
# marines of ours to take back.
sr_fl_9_can_land = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc
	sr_fl_9_marines_value >= 1
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 2 sr_loc_held_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 3 sr_loc_held_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 4 sr_loc_held_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 5 sr_loc_held_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 6 sr_loc_held_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 7 sr_loc_held_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 8 sr_loc_held_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 9 sr_loc_held_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
sr_fl_9_can_embark = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc
	sr_fl_9_marine_capacity > sr_fl_9_marines_value
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 2 sr_loc_our_marines_inner = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 3 sr_loc_our_marines_mars = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 4 sr_loc_our_marines_asteroids = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 5 sr_loc_our_marines_jupiter = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 6 sr_loc_our_marines_saturn = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 7 sr_loc_our_marines_uranus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 8 sr_loc_our_marines_neptune = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 9 sr_loc_our_marines_kuiper = yes }
	}
}
# 6b: a world at its location it may close in on (at war with its holder or
# occupier, or free); its target is one. At Earth, a lunar world (lunar
# colonization § 8.1).
sr_fl_9_has_hostile_world = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 1 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = shackleton } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = peary } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = tranquility } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = marius_hills } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = daedalus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = imbrium } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 2 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mercury } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 3 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 4 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pallas } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hygiea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 5 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = io } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = europa } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ganymede } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = callisto } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = himalia } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = amalthea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 6 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = titan } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = enceladus } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = rhea } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mimas } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = iapetus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 7 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = titania } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = oberon } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = miranda } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ariel } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 8 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = triton } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = proteus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 9 OR = { sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pluto } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = eris } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = makemake } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = haumea } sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = sedna } } }
	}
}

# 6c: a world at its location it may interdict (a country at peace with us,
# not our ally, holds it); its target is one; it interdicts. Never at Earth
# (lunar colonization § 8.3).
sr_fl_9_has_interdict_world = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 2 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mercury } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 3 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 4 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = pallas } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hygiea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 5 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = io } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = europa } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ganymede } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = callisto } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = himalia } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = amalthea } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 6 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = titan } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = enceladus } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = rhea } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mimas } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = iapetus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 7 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = titania } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = oberon } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = miranda } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ariel } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 8 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = triton } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = proteus } } }
		AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 9 OR = { sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = pluto } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = eris } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = makemake } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = haumea } sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = sedna } } }

sr_fl_9_interdicting = { sr_fl_9_posture_value = 4 }
# At Earth, closing in on a lunar world (the AI's offence leaves it there).
sr_fl_9_closing_at_earth = { sr_fl_9_at_earth = yes sr_fl_9_posture_value = 3 }
# The target button: interdicting, the worlds it may interdict; else the
# hostile worlds.
sr_fl_9_can_target = {
	OR = {
		AND = { sr_fl_9_posture_value = 4 sr_fl_9_has_interdict_world = yes }
		AND = { NOT = { sr_fl_9_posture_value = 4 } sr_fl_9_has_hostile_world = yes }
	}
}
# The posture button's next step is Interdict (its price, in the tooltip).
sr_fl_9_next_interdict = {
	sr_fl_9_has_interdict_world = yes
	OR = {
		sr_fl_9_posture_value = 3
		AND = { sr_fl_9_posture_value = 2 NOT = { sr_fl_9_has_hostile_world = yes } }
	}
}
# The AI's: at Earth, or where no world of ours is threatened.
sr_fl_9_ai_free = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc
	NOT = { OR = { AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 2 sr_fl_ai_threatened_inner = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 3 sr_fl_ai_threatened_mars = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 4 sr_fl_ai_threatened_asteroids = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 5 sr_fl_ai_threatened_jupiter = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 6 sr_fl_ai_threatened_saturn = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 7 sr_fl_ai_threatened_uranus = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 8 sr_fl_ai_threatened_neptune = yes } AND = { var:sr_fl_9_loc = 9 sr_fl_ai_threatened_kuiper = yes } } }
}
# It reaches Mercury and Venus within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_9_ai_reaches_inner = {
	OR = {
		sr_fl_9_leg_months_inner <= 6
		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_inner global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_inner >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_9_leg_months_inner } }
	}
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_9_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_9_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_9_return_dv_inner }
	}
}
# It reaches Mars within six months or before the first fleet bound there, and can
# come home again or dock there.
sr_fl_9_ai_reaches_mars = {
	OR = {
		sr_fl_9_leg_months_mars <= 6
		AND = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_mars global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_mars >= { value = te_history_month_index add = sr_fl_9_leg_months_mars } }

	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_mars = yes
		sr_fl_9_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_9_leg_dv_mars add = sr_fl_9_return_dv_mars }
	}
}

# 6c: it may attack Mercury and Venus: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_9_ai_attacks_inner = {
	sr_fl_9_docked = yes
	sr_fl_9_may_depart_inner = yes
	sr_fl_9_leg_months_inner <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_inner = yes
		sr_fl_9_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_9_leg_dv_inner add = sr_fl_9_return_dv_inner }
	}
	sr_fl_9_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_inner multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack Mars: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_9_ai_attacks_mars = {
	sr_fl_9_docked = yes
	sr_fl_9_may_depart_mars = yes
	sr_fl_9_leg_months_mars <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_mars = yes
		sr_fl_9_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_9_leg_dv_mars add = sr_fl_9_return_dv_mars }
	}
	sr_fl_9_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_mars multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}
# 6c: it may attack the Asteroid Belt: docked, within sr_fl_ai_attack_months' leg, able to
# come home again or dock there, and outmatching the enemy's force there
# (its fleets and its worlds' Defences) sr_fl_ai_attack_margin times over.
sr_fl_9_ai_attacks_asteroids = {
	sr_fl_9_docked = yes
	sr_fl_9_may_depart_asteroids = yes
	sr_fl_9_leg_months_asteroids <= sr_fl_ai_attack_months
	OR = {
		sr_loc_port_asteroids = yes
		sr_fl_9_dv_value >= { value = sr_fl_9_leg_dv_asteroids add = sr_fl_9_return_dv_asteroids }
	}
	sr_fl_9_strength >= { value = sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_asteroids multiply = sr_fl_ai_attack_margin }
}

# ===== Any slot =====
sr_fl_has_any = {
	OR = {
		sr_fl_1_exists = yes
		sr_fl_2_exists = yes
		sr_fl_3_exists = yes
		sr_fl_4_exists = yes
		sr_fl_5_exists = yes
		sr_fl_6_exists = yes
		sr_fl_7_exists = yes
		sr_fl_8_exists = yes
		sr_fl_9_exists = yes
	}
}
sr_fl_has_free_slot = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { sr_fl_1_exists = yes }
		NOT = { sr_fl_2_exists = yes }
		NOT = { sr_fl_3_exists = yes }
		NOT = { sr_fl_4_exists = yes }
		NOT = { sr_fl_5_exists = yes }
		NOT = { sr_fl_6_exists = yes }
		NOT = { sr_fl_7_exists = yes }
		NOT = { sr_fl_8_exists = yes }
		NOT = { sr_fl_9_exists = yes }
	}
}

# A fleet of ours is at, or bound for, the location CODE.
sr_fl_any_at_or_bound = {
	OR = {
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_1_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_dest var:sr_fl_1_dest = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_dest var:sr_fl_2_dest = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_dest var:sr_fl_3_dest = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_dest var:sr_fl_4_dest = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_dest var:sr_fl_5_dest = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_dest var:sr_fl_6_dest = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_dest var:sr_fl_7_dest = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_dest var:sr_fl_8_dest = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_dest var:sr_fl_9_dest = $CODE$ }
	}
}
# ... at it.
sr_fl_any_at = {
	OR = {
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_1_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = $CODE$ }
	}
}
# ... bound for it.
sr_fl_any_bound = {
	OR = {
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_dest var:sr_fl_1_dest = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_dest var:sr_fl_2_dest = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_dest var:sr_fl_3_dest = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_dest var:sr_fl_4_dest = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_dest var:sr_fl_5_dest = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_dest var:sr_fl_6_dest = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_dest var:sr_fl_7_dest = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_dest var:sr_fl_8_dest = $CODE$ }
		AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_dest var:sr_fl_9_dest = $CODE$ }
	}
}

# The scripted GUIs' slot (scope:op) passes the slot's TEST (exists, can_go, ...).
sr_fl_op_check = {
	OR = {
		AND = { scope:op = 1 sr_fl_1_$TEST$ = yes }
		AND = { scope:op = 2 sr_fl_2_$TEST$ = yes }
		AND = { scope:op = 3 sr_fl_3_$TEST$ = yes }
		AND = { scope:op = 4 sr_fl_4_$TEST$ = yes }
		AND = { scope:op = 5 sr_fl_5_$TEST$ = yes }
		AND = { scope:op = 6 sr_fl_6_$TEST$ = yes }
		AND = { scope:op = 7 sr_fl_7_$TEST$ = yes }
		AND = { scope:op = 8 sr_fl_8_$TEST$ = yes }
		AND = { scope:op = 9 sr_fl_9_$TEST$ = yes }
	}
}

# The alerts' uniform test at Earth: no alert there, although the Moon's
# colonies are at Earth (lunar colonization § 8), since a fleet bound for
# Earth is nearly always one coming home.
sr_loc_held_earth = { always = no }

# ===== Per location, country scope =====
#   sr_loc_held_<loc>             we hold a colony there, not occupied
#   sr_loc_port_<loc>             ... with a Spaceport
#   sr_loc_propellant_port_<loc>  ... on a propellant world
#   sr_loc_our_marines_<loc>      marines of ours stand at a world of ours there
#   sr_loc_garrison_due_<loc>     a world of ours there waits for its garrison
sr_loc_held_inner = {
	OR = {
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_venus } }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_mercury } }
	}
}
sr_loc_port_inner = {
	OR = {
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_venus } sr_site_port_value_venus >= 1 }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_mercury } sr_site_port_value_mercury >= 1 }
	}
}
sr_loc_our_marines_inner = {
	OR = {
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_venus } sr_site_marines_value_venus >= 1 }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_mercury } sr_site_marines_value_mercury >= 1 }
	}
}
sr_loc_garrison_due_inner = {
	OR = {
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_venus } has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_due_venus }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_mercury } has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_due_mercury }
	}
}
# A world of ours there, and an enemy fleet there or on its way (design § 14),
# or (6c) a fleet interdicting us there.
sr_fl_ai_threatened_inner = {
	sr_loc_held_inner = yes
	save_temporary_scope_as = sr_icpt_victim
	any_in_global_list = {
		variable = sr_fleet_powers
		is_country_alive = yes
		OR = {
			AND = {
				has_war_with = prev
				OR = { has_variable = sr_fl_at_inner sr_fl_any_bound = { CODE = 2 } }
			}
			sr_icpt_interdicts_at = { LOC = inner }
		}
	}
}
# 6c: a world there the AI may attack: held by a country at war with us, or
# ours under an enemy's occupation; never a free colony (design § 14).
sr_loc_ai_target_inner = {
	OR = {
		sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = venus }
		sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = mercury }
	}
}
# ... and our fleets there are a match for the enemy's (the AI stays).
sr_fl_ai_holds_inner = {
	has_variable = sr_fl_at_inner
	var:sr_fl_at_inner >= sr_loc_ai_enemy_fleets_inner
}

	OR = {

		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_olympus_mons } }

		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_arcadia_planitia } }

		}
	}
}
# 6c: a world there the AI may attack: held by a country at war with us, or
# ours under an enemy's occupation; never a free colony (design § 14).

sr_loc_held_uranus = {
	OR = {
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titania ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_titania } }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_oberon } }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_miranda } }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ariel } }
	}
}
sr_loc_port_uranus = {
	OR = {
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titania ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_titania } sr_site_port_value_titania >= 1 }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_oberon } sr_site_port_value_oberon >= 1 }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_miranda } sr_site_port_value_miranda >= 1 }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ariel } sr_site_port_value_ariel >= 1 }
	}
}
sr_loc_our_marines_uranus = {
	OR = {
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titania ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_titania } sr_site_marines_value_titania >= 1 }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_oberon } sr_site_marines_value_oberon >= 1 }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_miranda } sr_site_marines_value_miranda >= 1 }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ariel } sr_site_marines_value_ariel >= 1 }
	}
}
sr_loc_garrison_due_uranus = {
	OR = {
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titania ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_titania } has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_due_titania }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_oberon } has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_due_oberon }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_miranda } has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_due_miranda }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ariel } has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_due_ariel }
	}
}
# A world of ours there, and an enemy fleet there or on its way (design § 14),
# or (6c) a fleet interdicting us there.
sr_fl_ai_threatened_uranus = {
	sr_loc_held_uranus = yes
	save_temporary_scope_as = sr_icpt_victim
	any_in_global_list = {
		variable = sr_fleet_powers
		is_country_alive = yes
		OR = {
			AND = {
				has_war_with = prev
				OR = { has_variable = sr_fl_at_uranus sr_fl_any_bound = { CODE = 7 } }
			}
			sr_icpt_interdicts_at = { LOC = uranus }
		}
	}
}
